name: claude-essentials
description: A public marketplace of Claude Code plugins, skills, and agents — install via /plugin marketplace add nerymurillohnd/claude-essentials.

plugins.name: agent-self-knowledge
plugins.description: Stops Claude from answering about Claude Code from memory. Its skill queries the live official documentation, the upstream changelog and the npm registry, then answers with the exact sentence quoted verbatim, the source URL, and the version it verified against — and reports what it could not find instead of filling the gap.

plugins.name: block-no-verify
plugins.description: Stops Claude from skipping your Git hooks or commit signing: only when you ask and approve a scope, its skill installs a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that denies Git commands Claude runs with --no-verify, -n, --no-gpg-sign, core.hooksPath overrides, HUSKY=0, and similar bypasses. Installing the plugin wires nothing, and it never controls your own terminal or CI.

plugins.name: ruff-quality
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the current Ruff workflow for Python (safe fixes, format, check; configuration discovery; rule selection after Ruff 0.16; migration from Black, isort, and Flake8; pre-commit and CI), and, only when you ask and choose a scope and a configuration, installs Claude Code hooks that fix, format, and lint every Python file Claude edits, deny suppression comments and configuration changes, and keep Claude from finishing until the files are clean.

plugins.name: shell-quality
plugins.description: Teaches Claude the current ShellCheck and shfmt workflow for shell scripts (format, then check; rc files and EditorConfig; correct fixes for common SC codes; macOS Bash 3.2 portability; pre-commit and CI), and, only when you ask and choose a scope and a configuration, installs Claude Code hooks that format and check every shell script Claude edits, deny suppression directives and configuration changes, and keep Claude from finishing until the scripts are clean.

plugins.name: verify-completion
plugins.description: Makes Claude prove work is done before saying so: a six-gate verification skill with coherence and depth audits, a read-only verifier agent scaled to the size of the change, an opt-in workflow that cross-checks every finding, and a Stop hook that sends Claude back for a checkable Verification record when a reply presents finished work without one. It never authorizes commits, pushes, or deploys.
